breakdown.description: The sum of phase volume fractions must equal 1. In the `regions` section of the `setFieldsDict`, `alpha.air` (0.4) and `alpha.water` (0.7) sum to 1.1, which is physically impossible.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification corrected alpha.water from 0.7 to 0.6 in the regions section, so alpha.air (0.4) + alpha.water (0.6) = 1.0, matching the ground truth. The agent also corrected the default field values to alpha.air=1.0 and alpha.water=0.0, consistent with the ground truth.
